description: The file is a PHP class named WelcomeController extending AbstractInstallerVueController, involved in the initial setup or welcome stage of the installer for the OrangeHRM system. It sets up a Vue component for the welcome screen and manages state related to the installation process.

classes.name: WelcomeController
classes.description: Controller class for handling the welcome screen of the installer, extending AbstractInstallerVueController, configuring the Vue component for the welcome page, and managing installation state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Overrides a method to prepare the welcome component for rendering, setting up the Vue component with product version and updating the installer state.
